deterministic_branch.source_clause: The operator of a bus, other than a tour bus, shall: Enter a bus stop, bus stand, passenger loading zone or origin or destination point on a public street in such a manner that the bus when stopped to load or unload passengers or baggage shall be in a position with the right-hand front wheel of such vehicle not farther than eighteen inches from the curb and the bus approximately parallel to the curb so as not to unduly impede the movement of other vehicular traffic.

judgment_context.note: Curb heading difference is measured, but the statute supplies no numeric angular threshold; original geometry needs independent review.
judgment_context.reason: Original heading and following-traffic source review is held fixed across the wheel-gap pair; physical outcome is audited after capture.

judgment_context.note: Other vehicle speed and delay are measured, but the statute supplies no numerical undue-impedance cutoff; traffic context needs independent review.
judgment_context.reason: Original heading and following-traffic source review is held fixed across the wheel-gap pair; physical outcome is audited after capture.
